Name: Revolver

Name: Mirror Fragments

Testimonies:
Testimony 0
Testimony: It's true, sir! I wasn't assigned to this area, sir!
Person: Meekins
Testimony 1
Testimony: I was told to check every square inch of the main gate area, sir!
Person: Meekins
Testimony 2
Testimony: I also went looking for the kidnappers while selling dreams in the Blue Badgermobile, sir!
Person: Meekins
Testimony 3
Testimony: But! I got completely caught up in my role, selling dreams to the children! SIR!
Person: Meekins
Testimony 4
Testimony: Before I knew it, I found myself here in this area, sir!
Person: Meekins

Which evidence and testimony contradict each other? You must only answer one pair. You may output an explanation, but your answer must end with a JSON format like so: {"evidence": 2, "testimony": 3}. The answer JSON should strictly be the last line, with nothing before or after it.
cot:
We need to find a pair where evidence contradicts testimony. Look at testimonies from Meekins (character 7). They claim various things: "I wasn't assigned to this area", "I was told to check every square inch of the main gate area", "I also went looking for the kidnappers while selling dreams in the Blue Badgermobile", "But! I got completely caught up in my role, selling dreams to the children!", "Before I knew it, I found myself here in this area". Need evidence that contradicts any of these statements.

Evidence list: 8 is Blue Badgermobile, says it was parked inside Wild, Wild West area garage the whole time. No mud on tires. That contradicts testimony 2: Meekins says he was selling dreams in the Blue Badgermobile while looking for kidnappers. If the Blue Badgermobile was parked whole time, he couldn't have been selling dreams in it. So evidence 8 contradicts testimony 2.

Thus answer pair: evidence 8, testimony 2.

Check other possibilities: Evidence 2 Bad Badger's Head left in Isolation Room; testimony about being in area? Not directly. Evidence 9 Victim's Costume etc. Not.

Thus output JSON. Ensure explanation before JSON allowed but final line must be JSON only. Provide explanation then JSON line.
